title_en: The Status of the Intellectually and Ideologically Impaired (Mustad'af) Regarding Hereafter Punishment, Episode 9
description_en: The status of the intellectually and ideologically impaired (mustad'af) regarding hereafter punishment, part 9, from advanced lessons in principles of jurisprudence (usul al-fiqh) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure).
summary: This lesson examines theological and jurisprudential principles concerning the ultimate accountability and hereafter punishment of those who are intellectually or informationally deprived of the truth.
series_en: The Status of the Intellectually and Ideologically Impaired (Mustad'af) Regarding Hereafter Punishment
